paired_statistics.interpretation: Paired synthetic outcomes; p-value is descriptive only and does not adjust for within-seed or within-format dependence. At least five independent seed clusters are needed for a seed-level interval. No evidence of real LLM improvement without actual live-model experiments and larger heldout sets.

protocol.evaluation: score each actual execution before its feedback; only selected memory learns
protocol.recommendation_gate: positive total gain and no scenario loss; review only
protocol.selection: none; one fixed hypothesis, no tuning

replay_protection: operator-owned SQLite; not independent test custody
scope: Public synthetic prospective test-then-train; no sealed holdout, weight training or scientific discovery.
